rows.Origin:
Bred by Colin Dickson (1956-....) (United Kingdom, before 2009).
Introduced in United Kingdom by Dickson Nurseries Ltd. / Dickson Roses in 2009 as 'Alexander's Issie'.
rows.Bloom: Pink, red shading. Average diameter 3.25". Double (17-25 petals), cluster-flowered, scalloped bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Large, semi-glossy, dark green foliage.

Height: 31" (80cm). Width: 2' (60cm).
rows.Parentage:
Pensioner's Voice (floribunda, Fryer before 1987) ×
Simply Heaven
rows.Notes:
Named by fashion designer Alexander McQueen in memory of his friend and mentor, Isabella Blow (November 1958 London - May 7, 2007 Gloucester), magazine editor.
Parentage: Pensioner's Voice x Simply Heaven according to Member comments
